notes: SocialBranch video support + smart network gating. Added accepts:'image|video|both' to each NETWORK; auto-detects mediaType from data URL / file extension; compose now gates network checkboxes by media compatibility (video hides GMB, photo hides YouTube/TikTok). Preview shows <video> tag with 🎥 badge for video items. Webhook payload now includes mediaType, videoUrl, mediaUrl, youtubeTitle fields for Make router to key off of.
